description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Financial' that provides static methods for various financial calculations, most of which are deprecated and delegate to methods in other classes. It acts as a facade for a comprehensive library of financial functions related to securities, depreciation, interest rates, cash flows, and more, within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation namespace.

classes.name: Financial
classes.description: A facade class providing static methods for various financial calculations in the PhpSpreadsheet library. Some methods are deprecated and delegate to specific classes handling detailed implementations, including securities, amortization, coupons, depreciation, interest rates, and treasury bills.

methods.name: ACCRINT
methods.description: Returns the accrued interest for a security that pays periodic interest. Delegates to Securities\AccruedInterest::periodic().

methods.name: ACCRINTM
methods.description: Returns the accrued interest for a security that pays interest at maturity. Delegates to Securities\AccruedInterest::atMaturity().

methods.name: AMORDEGRC
methods.description: Returns the depreciation for each accounting period, applying depreciation coefficient. Delegates to Amortization::AMORDEGRC().

methods.name: AMORLINC
methods.description: Returns the depreciation for each accounting period for linear depreciation. Delegates to Amortization::AMORLINC().

methods.name: COUPDAYBS
methods.description: Returns days from the beginning of coupon period to settlement date. Delegates to Coupons::COUPDAYBS().

methods.name: COUPDAYS
methods.description: Returns the number of days in the coupon period containing the settlement date. Delegates to Coupons::COUPDAYS().

methods.name: COUPDAYSNC
methods.description: Returns days from the settlement date to next coupon date. Delegates to Coupons::COUPDAYSNC().

methods.name: COUPNCD
methods.description: Returns the next coupon date after settlement. Delegates to Coupons::COUPNCD().

methods.name: COUPNUM
methods.description: Returns the number of coupons payable between settlement and maturity date. Delegates to Coupons::COUPNUM().

methods.name: COUPPCD
methods.description: Returns the previous coupon date before settlement. Delegates to Coupons::COUPPCD().

methods.name: CUMIPMT
methods.description: Returns the cumulative interest paid on a loan between start and end periods. Delegates to Financial\CashFlow\Constant\Periodic\Cumulative::interest().

methods.name: CUMPRINC
methods.description: Returns the cumulative principal paid on a loan between start and end periods. Delegates to Financial\CashFlow\Constant\Periodic\Cumulative::principal().

methods.name: DB
methods.description: Returns depreciation of an asset for a specified period using fixed-declining balance method. Delegates to Depreciation::DB().

methods.name: DDB
methods.description: Returns depreciation of an asset using double-declining balance or other specified method. Delegates to Depreciation::DDB().

methods.name: DISC
methods.description: Returns discount rate for a security. Delegates to Securities\Rates::discount().

methods.name: DOLLARDE
methods.description: Converts fractional dollar price into decimal dollar price. Delegates to Dollar::decimal().

methods.name: DOLLARFR
methods.description: Converts decimal dollar price into fractional dollar price. Delegates to Dollar::fractional().

methods.name: EFFECT
methods.description: Returns effective interest rate given nominal rate and number of compounding periods. Delegates to Financial\InterestRate::effective().

methods.name: FV
methods.description: Calculates future value of cash flows with constant payments and interest rate. Delegates to Financial\CashFlow\Constant\Periodic::futureValue().

methods.name: FVSCHEDULE
methods.description: Returns future value of an initial amount after applying a series of interest rates. Delegates to Financial\CashFlow\Single::futureValue().

methods.name: INTRATE
methods.description: Returns interest rate for a fully invested security. Delegates to Financial\Securities\Rates::interest().

methods.name: IPMT
methods.description: Returns interest payment for a given period. Delegates to Financial\CashFlow\Constant\Periodic\Interest::payment().

methods.name: IRR
methods.description: Returns internal rate of return for a series of cash flows. Delegates to Financial\CashFlow\Variable\Periodic::rate().

methods.name: ISPMT
methods.description: Returns interest payment for an investment based on schedule. Delegates to Financial\CashFlow\Constant\Periodic\Interest::schedulePayment().

methods.name: MIRR
methods.description: Returns modified internal rate of return considering reinvestment. Delegates to Financial\CashFlow\Variable\Periodic::modifiedRate().

methods.name: NOMINAL
methods.description: Returns nominal interest rate from effective rate. Delegates to InterestRate::nominal().

methods.name: NPER
methods.description: Returns number of periods for a cash flow. Delegates to Financial\CashFlow\Constant\Periodic::periods().

methods.name: NPV
methods.description: Returns net present value of a cash flow series. Delegates to Financial\CashFlow\Variable\Periodic::presentValue().

methods.name: PDURATION
methods.description: Calculates number of periods required for an investment to reach a value. Delegates to Financial\CashFlow\Single::periods().

methods.name: PMT
methods.description: Returns constant payment for a cash flow. Delegates to Financial\CashFlow\Constant\Periodic\Payments::annuity().

methods.name: PPMT
methods.description: Returns interest payment for a specific period. Delegates to Financial\CashFlow\Constant\Periodic\Payments::interestPayment().

methods.name: PRICE
methods.description: Returns price of security paying periodic interest. Delegates to Securities\Price::price().

methods.name: PRICEDISC
methods.description: Returns discounted security price. Delegates to Securities\Price::priceDiscounted().

methods.name: PRICEMAT
methods.description: Returns price of interest-at-maturity security. Delegates to Securities\Price::priceAtMaturity().

methods.name: PV
methods.description: Calculates present value of cash flows. Delegates to Financial\CashFlow\Constant\Periodic::presentValue().

methods.name: RATE
methods.description: Returns interest rate per period of an annuity. Delegates to Financial\CashFlow\Constant\Periodic\Interest::rate().

methods.name: RECEIVED
methods.description: Returns amount received at maturity of security. Delegates to Securities\Price::received().

methods.name: RRI
methods.description: Returns interest rate for investment growth to a target. Delegates to Financial\CashFlow\Single::interestRate().

methods.name: SLN
methods.description: Returns straight-line depreciation of an asset. Delegates to Depreciation::SLN().

methods.name: SYD
methods.description: Returns sum-of-years' digits depreciation of an asset. Delegates to Depreciation::SYD().

methods.name: TBILLEQ
methods.description: Returns bond-equivalent yield for Treasury bill. Delegates to TreasuryBill::bondEquivalentYield().

methods.name: TBILLPRICE
methods.description: Returns price per $100 face value of Treasury bill. Delegates to TreasuryBill::price().

methods.name: TBILLYIELD
methods.description: Returns yield of Treasury bill. Delegates to TreasuryBill::yield().

methods.name: XIRR
methods.description: Returns internal rate of return for non-periodic cash flows. Delegates to Financial\CashFlow\Variable\NonPeriodic::rate().

methods.name: XNPV
methods.description: Returns net present value for non-periodic cash flows. Delegates to Financial\CashFlow\Variable\NonPeriodic::presentValue().

methods.name: YIELDDISC
methods.description: Returns yield of discounted security. Delegates to Securities\Yields::yieldDiscounted().

methods.name: YIELDMAT
methods.description: Returns yield of maturity security. Delegates to Securities\Yields::yieldAtMaturity().
